meta.name: autoskill
meta.description: Observe the user's screen via screenpipe, detect repeated research workflows, match them against existing scientific-agent-skills, and draft new skills (or composition recipes that chain existing ones) for the patterns not yet covered. Use when the user asks to analyze their recent work and propose skills based on what they actually do. Requires the screenpipe daemon (https://github.com/screenpipe/screenpipe) running locally on port 3030 — the skill has no other data source and will refuse to run if screenpipe is unreachable. All detection runs locally; only redacted cluster summaries reach the LLM.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 观察你的屏幕操作,自动找出重复流程并生成新技能建议
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望助手能根据你日常操作自动沉淀成可复用的技能
copy.tagline_en: Watch your screen, find repeated workflows, auto-suggest new skills
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your agent to turn your daily habits into reusable skills

howto.what: 该技能赋予 Claude 一项能力：从本地 screenpipe 获取近期屏幕活动，将重复操作聚成工作模式，与仓库中已有技能比对；对未覆盖的模式会生成新 SKILL.md 或组合配方，存入 ~/.autoskill/proposed 供审阅。
howto.when: 仅当用户明确要求基于近期屏幕活动分析工作并提出新技能或组合配方时触发；技能不会自行启动，也不响应实时屏幕查询。

say.text: 分析我最近一天的工作，提议可自动化的新技能。
say.note: 将生成新技能草案供你审查。

say.text: 查看我这周重复的操作，哪些还没有技能覆盖？
say.note: 会与现有技能比对并列出差距。

say.text: 根据我最近的科研工作流，帮我起草一个组合配方。
say.note: 会输出可用的 SKILL.md 草稿。

howto.what_en: When called, it retrieves the screen timeline from local screenpipe, clusters repeated actions, matches them to existing skills, and writes draft SKILL.md files or composition recipes (for patterns not yet covered) into ~/.autoskill/proposed for user review.
howto.when_en: Triggered only when the user explicitly asks to analyze their recent screen activity and propose new skills or composition recipes, e.g. 'analyze my last day of work'.

say_en.text: Analyze my last day of work and propose a skill that can automate it.
say_en.note: Will write a new skill draft to the proposed folder.

say_en.text: Check my repeated operations this week and tell me what isn't covered.
say_en.note: Compares activity clusters with existing skills.

say_en.text: Draft a composition recipe from my recent research workflow.
say_en.note: Creates a SKILL.md draft for your review.
